sources.label: AI was used in the making of these patches.
sources.author: byehi98
patch_list: Every gun, skin, glove and drone shows as unlocked, and you can equip any of them. Your save file is not changed.
Reward buttons pay out instantly. Tap once and you get the reward, with no ad to watch.
Your cash, gold and diamonds always show the maximum. You never run short of money.
